text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board. This report recommends two candidates for appointment to fill current vacancies on the board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 25, 2025, and until successors are appointed: - Karin Fritzlar - Alec Wieczorek
